references.text: Aaron's holy garments were to pass down to his sons after him, as a sign that the priesthood was transferred from father to son.
The fulfillment of the command where Moses removes Aaron's garments and puts them on Eleazar, and Aaron dies on the mountain.
A parallel account of Aaron's death on Mount Hor in the fortieth year after leaving Egypt.
Another account of Aaron's death and that Eleazar became priest in his place.
Moses is told that he will die on the mountain, just as Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his fathers.
The expression 'to be gathered' is also used concerning Abraham's death, describing the transition to the realm of the dead and union with the ancestors.
Jacob was also 'gathered to his people' when he died, using the same expression as for Aaron's death.
The description of the holy garments made for Aaron, which were now to be transferred to Eleazar.
